DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0), @process_date  date, @task_name varchar(100)
set @process_date = '2024-03-29'
set @task_name = 'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM'

    SELECT --*
	@FLAG_CNT=(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
	INNER JOIN
		[EDS].[DATE_DIM] EDD
		ON
		EDD.FULLDATE = @process_date 
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASKS] OT
		ON
		OT.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
		ON
		OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME
		AND CASE WHEN OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' AND EDD.BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'N' THEN EDD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
				 ELSE EDD.FULLDATE END = OTR.PROCESS_DATE
	LEFT JOIN   
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name)
		AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y'
	GROUP BY
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME

	IF(@FLAG_CNT<>1)   
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'JOB '+@task_name+' SOURCES ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN TABLE FOR LIST OF SOURCES THAT ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE';   
	  
			THROW 80000, @errmsg1, 1;  
		END
	ELSE
		select 'PROCEED TO INGESTION'




SELECT @FLAG_CNT

SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME IN (SELECT TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY WHERE DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM') AND PROCESS_DATE BETWEEN '2024-03-26' AND '2024-04-01'
 

update  om.om_task_run set process_date = '2024-03-29' where process_date = '2024-03-28' and task_name IN ( 'TSK_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB','TSK_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION','TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS')

update  om.om_task_run set process_date = '2024-03-27' where process_date = '2024-03-26' and task_name IN ( 'TSK_EDS_CRM_ADDRESS')

alter table om.om_task_dependency
drop column ismain

create table om.om_task_dependency_bu_20240723 
with (
	heap,
	distribution = round_robin
)
as
select * from om.om_task_dependency

create table om.om_task_dependency
with (
	heap,
	distribution = round_robin
)
as
select DEPENDENCY_ID,TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,MONTHEND FROM  om.om_task_dependency_bu_20240723
